item.subject: science
item.stem:
In her school science exhibition in Pune, Meera builds a model showing what would happen if Earth were much larger than it is, so its gravity became much stronger.

Why would this make it harder for Earth to support life?

options.A: A much larger planet would always be too far from the Sun to stay warm.
options.B: Much stronger gravity could crush living beings and change the atmosphere the planet can hold.
options.C: A much larger planet would have no water on its surface.
options.D: A much larger planet would spin too fast for day and night to occur.
